title: Phase 1 — trusted authorization + read-only operational status foundation for PAIR Chat
description: BASE staging/pr59-safe@5b5ab73 (post Phase C merge). Adds the governed read-only status foundation behind ConversationReasoningService.observeOperatorContext: (1) TRUSTED BOUNDARY — mission-control-server classifies the presented credential via classifyRequestCredential(): the separate PAIR_MC_ADMIN_TOKEN (env-only via resolveMcAdminToken; never generated/persisted/defaulted; equal-to-MC-token disables the lane) mints an `admin` ConversationPrincipal, the MC token only ever mints `operator`, x-operator-id stays a claimed identity rebound to the verified session owner (normalizePrincipal), telegram ingress mints `telegram` — never admin. (2) NEW OperationalQueryService composes bounded STATUS envelopes over canonical store rows + MissionControl projections: intents (ACTIVE_WORK/PROVIDER_STATUS/ATTENTION/COST/GENERIC) via weighted bilingual phrase lexicon; admin gets global evidence, scoped principals get only canonically-proven scope (owner_authority_id objectives, BUSINESS_CREATED actor chain, work_open_binding-bound missions, own conversation drafts) — everything else reports unavailable:INSUFFICIENT_AUTHORITY; held/committed/settled microusd kept distinct, unpriced_dispatches never rendered as zero; integrity failures surface as integrity[] typed codes; sections capped before serialization and the prompt STATUS block is always valid JSON (over-bound → ENVELOPE_EXCEEDS_BOUND marker, never a sliced fragment). (3) INTEGRATION — hook receives {principal, session_id, committed latest_message, bounded context_tail}; it runs only after reply-idempotency replay and the stale-turn gate, mints zero missions/plans/drafts/executions, and mutates nothing. PAIR_PROPOSAL/draft/confirm/ack flows unchanged.
